Amends title 38 of the United States Code to add a single recurring reporting mandate.
dimensions.evidence: Section 3736 of title 38, United States Code, is amended-- (1) by striking 'The annual report' and inserting '(a) The annual report'; and (2) by adding at the end the following new subsection
submit to the Committees on Veterans' Affairs of the House of Representatives and the Senate a quarterly report
